issue.title: [Control practice 4] CSV import fails without shared input
issue.body:
Invented sandbox practice report.

On DuckDB 1.5 CLI on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, running `SELECT * FROM read_csv('input.csv');` fails with `Conversion Error: CSV Error on Line: 4`. I have not included the input CSV or its contents. Expected: the CSV imports successfully. Actual: the conversion error above.
